quotes.basis: Article states: development potential ~1.3 mn sq ft, gross development value (GDV) >₹3,000 crore for the Sector 59 land parcel acquired for ₹534 crore. Computed ₹3,000,00,00,000 / 1,300,000 sq ft => ₹23,077/sq ft implied average realisation (a company-stated GDV/area projection, NOT a per-unit launch price — project had not formally launched as of Sep 2025/Apr 2026 filings; company targets launches 'from Q3 FY26 onwards').

sector_news.headline: Golf Course Extension Road property prices double in 5 years
sector_news.figure: GCER (Golf Course Extension Road) corridor: new-launch rates rose from ~₹8,800/sq ft (2019) to ~₹20,267/sq ft (2024); resale values up ~79% over the same period, pushing many multistorey apartments into the ₹17,000+/sq ft bracket. Corridor-level, not sector-63/65/66/67-specific.

sector_news.headline: Area watch | DLF to Trump Towers: SPR is new hotspot in Gurugram real estate
sector_news.figure: Per Magicbricks data for Jan-Mar 2025, Sector 69 along SPR commands an average rate of ₹13,892/sq ft.

sector_news.headline: SPR, Sohna emerge as South Gurugram's next real estate growth engines as prices surge
sector_news.figure: Per Magicbricks data: SPR corridor average residential price ~₹16,249/sq ft in 2026 (+18.4% YoY), up 165% over 5 years from ~₹9,800/sq ft. Corridor-level (SPR runs through sector 70 and neighbouring sectors), not sector-70-specific.

sector_news.headline: Gurugram's SPR to become key realty hub in Delhi-NCR
sector_news.figure: Weighted average new-launch price on SPR rose from ₹7,693/sq ft (2020) to ₹17,123/sq ft (end 2024), a 125% increase; residential launches on SPR up 584% over 5 years. Corridor-level.
